messages:
emma_sales: Heads up 1: BankCorp wants a 2-week air-gapped POC. Key asks: vendor-signed bundle with verifiable provenance, option for customer-controlled signing via their Thales HSM, clear offline reserved capacity pricing, and a documented upgrade/rollback cadence. Can we scope?

raj_se: We can provide a signed tarball + SBOM + signature file. For customer signing we support integrating their signing endpoint or using an HSM proxy. Need to confirm whether they need signing at our build time or if they want to re-sign after we ship. Different effort.

emma_sales: They want to re-sign themselves after we hand off the bundle (customer-owned key). Also asked for a verification snippet they can run in their staging environment.

liya_security: Note: BankCorp requires FIPS 140-2 compatibility for signing and an audit trail of who performed signing operations. If they re-sign, our runbook should include verification steps and a statement about non-repudiation. I'll prepare the questionnaire language.

raj_se: Example verification to give them: 

```
# verify signature with vendor pubkey
cosign verify --key vendor.pub bundle.tar.gz.sig
# verify checksums in manifest
jq -r '.images[] | .sha256 + "  " + .filename' bundle_manifest.json | sha256sum -c -
```

And a small helper script we can provide for ops to check SBOM presence + manifest integrity.

tess_sre: Operational constraints: our air-gapped delta pipeline supports cumulative patches every ~90 days by default. Emergency critical CVE hotfixes we aim to ship in 14-30 days depending on severity and test matrix. For the POC we can fast-track a single hotfix in ~7 business days if needed.

emma_sales: Good. They also asked about how big deltas are (bandwidth estimate) and maintenance window recommendations.

tess_sre: Deltas vary; small security patches are typically <100MB, feature rollups can be multiple GBs. Recommend maintenance windows: 30-60 minutes for small patches, 2-4 hours for rollups. If they're using USB transport (sneakernet) factor in manual steps. We'll include a short table in the runbook.

liya_security: For the security questionnaire: if they want customer key control, we need to document supported key custody modes: (1) Customer manages signing in their HSM and re-signs shipped bundles; (2) Customer provides HSM access/integration for Redwood to sign on their behalf (audit logs provided); (3) Vendor-signed with exportable audit trail only. We should ask which option they prefer.

emma_sales: BankCorp prefers option 1. They also asked whether we can automate verification in their CI.

raj_se: We can provide a small verification action they can drop into their CI that runs the cosign + manifest checks and fails the pipeline on mismatch. Low effort.

deploy-bot: Ticket SALES-9082 opened for "BankCorp air-gapped POC: bundle handoff + Thales HSM path" by emma_sales.

tess_sre: PS / eng effort for Thales integration (customer-run signing flow): if they only re-sign after receiving the bundle, zero integration work required from eng (we just produce the artifacts). If they want Redwood to sign using their HSM (we call into their Thales), estimate ~3-5 engineering days + 2 days ops testing + PS-runbook. Quote as a PS line item.

emma_sales: OK please prepare two quotes: (A) standard air-gapped POC (we produce signed vendor bundle + verification scripts; customer re-signs in their env) and (B) add-on Thales HSM integration where Redwood signs into their HSM. Include timelines and PS hours.

liya_security: I'll draft answers to the questionnaire, including FIPS wording and recommended attestation language. Also will note that our vendor signing keys are rotated annually and we can provide signing cert chains on request.

raj_se: One more technical note: rolling back a delta is supported only if they preserve previous bundle artifacts; we recommend retaining previous bundle tarballs for at least one release cycle. We'll add rollback steps to the runbook.

emma_sales: Deliverables and timeline: 
- raj: verification script + sample cosign commands by Monday EOD
- tess: runbook excerpt with delta size table, maintenance window guidance, rollback steps by Monday EOD
- liya: security questionnaire answers + FIPS clause draft by Monday EOD

emma_sales: Aim to send the package to BankCorp Tuesday morning. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

tess_sre: I'll also include a quick checklist for their ops team: preflight checks, disk space, checksum verification, and post-install smoke tests.

liya_security: Adding legal to loop for FIPS phrasing now.

emma_sales: Perfect. I'll update CRM and attach SALES-9082.
